It is authored under targetKind 'save' because that is where a player will look and there is no defence-DC target kind, but the display text must say 'DC', otherwise players will add it to a save they roll. The Make Them Fall reaction is a misfortune effect, not a bonus.

name: Locket of Love Left Behind
engineNote: The second half — 'If you are dying, the DC of recovery checks is reduced by 1' — is a DC reduction on the flat check made while dying, not a bonus to any tracked statistic. There is no target kind for recovery checks / the dying flat check, so it is unrepresented; it would be worth surfacing next to HP or the dying tracker. The True Love's Power reaction cheats death and grants no bonus.

name: Silversoul Bomb (Greater)
engineNote: One genuinely conditional clause exists but has no representable target: "Against nindorus, the bomb's item bonus also applies to its save DC to resist being dazzled or blinded." That is a bonus to the ITEM's save DC against a single creature type — the target-kind list has no item/effect-DC stat and no creature-type predicate. Splash/persistent damage and the blinded/dazzled riders are effects on the target, not bonuses to the thrower.

name: Silversoul Bomb (Major)
engineNote: Same untargetable clause as the Greater version: "Against nindorus, the bomb's item bonus also applies to its save DC to resist being dazzled or blinded" — an item save-DC bonus predicated on creature type, with no matching target kind.

name: Stalwart's Banner (Greater)
engineNote: MISSING TARGET: the printed bonus is to your Fortitude DC and Reflex DC — the DC an opponent rolls against (Athletics to Shove/Trip/Grapple), which the app has no stat for; the target-kind list has ac/classDc but no save DC. The entries are anchored to the Fortitude/Reflex rows purely so the player can see them, and the bonus text says so explicitly — this value must NOT be added to save rolls. Second gap: the effect also covers allies in the aura, and there is no ally-facing modelling. The 10 temporary Hit Points are a play resource, not a bonus.

name: Stalwart's Banner (Major)
engineNote: Same missing target as the Greater banner: bonus is to Fortitude DC / Reflex DC (the DC opponents roll against), which has no stat in the app, and it also applies to allies in the aura, which has no modelling. 15 temporary HP is a play resource, not a bonus.

engineNote: Same gap as tenderizer-grenade-greater — no engine lane for a bomb's intrinsic item bonus to attack rolls.

engineNote: Two issues. (1) Save keyed 'all' because the text says "saves", not one save — in practice inhaled poisons are Fortitude, but inhaled mental/hallucinogenic effects would be Will. Merely carrying the bottle must not light up the star, so the item lane needs an 'active effect' gate rather than a possession check.

engineNote: (1) Consumable: the bonus only exists after eating it and lasts until the next morning, so possession alone must not light the star. engineNote: Two problems. (1) Same missing lane as the tenderizer grenades: no engine support for a bomb's intrinsic item bonus to attack rolls. engineNote: Same two problems as aon-peshspine-grenade: no engine lane for a bomb's intrinsic item bonus to attack rolls, and this one AoN record lumps all four grades (with +0/+1/+2/+3 and different damage) into a single entry, so the correct value is indeterminate until the record is split per grade.

name: Fixer
engineNote: Gather Information / Make an Impression / Request are Diplomacy actions and Impersonate / Lie are Deception actions, hence the split; Recall Knowledge needs skill:'all' since it can use any knowledge skill or Lore. The bonus is delivered by an NPC Aiding you, so it only exists while the hireling is present and in their location.

name: Fulcrum Lenses
engineNote: The Ebon lens's "+1 item bonus to attack rolls, saving throws, and DCs" covers class DC and spell DC, hence the classDc + spell pair; if 'spell' means spell attack rolls rather than spell DC in this codebase, the mapping needs checking. The Emerald lens's "harm spells gain a +4 status bonus to the Hit Points they restore to you" is a bonus to healing RECEIVED — there is no target kind for that and it must not be mapped onto hp (max HP). Resistance 10 to mental, negative healing, incorporeal and drained 2 are not typed bonuses.

name: Energy Robe
engineNote: Only the fire variant grants a typed bonus. The cold variant grants water walk, the acid variant a climb Speed and the electricity variant a fly Speed — those are new movement types, not bonuses to the existing Speed, so they must not be added to the Speed number. The resistance 5 is already handled by the record's effectChoices/passive resistances. The Speed bonus exists only for 1 minute after the once-per-day activation, so it should be gated on an active effect rather than on wearing the robe; and it should only show when the robe-energy choice is 'fire'.

name: Enhanced Hearing Aid
engineNote: Doubly conditional: only hearing-based Perception, and only during the 10-minute once-per-day activation window (requires the hearing aids to be on). Possession alone should not light the star.

name: Inubrix Armor
engineNote: This is a precious-material template record (acBonus 0), not a wearable suit. Applying it needs a material lane that adjusts the base armour's acBonus/dexCap and adds the flexible trait — nothing to do with situational bonuses.

name: Inubrix Shield
engineNote: The magnitude is not a fixed number — it is copied from the shield's (or its boss's/spikes') own item bonus to attack rolls, which is 0 unless the shield attachment carries potency. The SituationalBonus.bonus field is a free string so the wording works, but a player-facing value cannot be shown without reading the wielded shield. Also note this record is a material template (hardness/hp/BT all 0) covering four grades in one description.

name: Inubrix Buckler (Standard-Grade)
engineNote: Same variable-magnitude problem as aon-inubrix-shield: the bonus equals the wielded shield's item bonus to attack rolls rather than a fixed number.

name: Inubrix Weapon
engineNote: Material template record. Correct handling is a material lane that steps the base weapon's damage die down one size and flags 'ignores metal armor specialization resistance / metal shield circumstance AC / doesn't trigger metal Shield Block' — none of it belongs in situationalBonuses.

name: Noqual
engineNote: Save keyed 'all' — the text says "saves" without naming one. The other half, "+4 circumstance bonus on saves against magic that the item attempts", is the OBJECT's save and must not appear on the character. This is a precious-material record (itemType treasure), so the marker would have to key off owning noqual gear, which the item lane cannot currently express.

name: Noqual Object (Standard-Grade)
engineNote: Same as aon-noqual: save keyed 'all', and the object's own +4 save is the object's, not the owner's.

name: Hopeful Athamaru
engineNote: The bonus never applies to this character — it applies to allies standing in the aura. There is no target kind for "another creature's checks", so the entry above is a placeholder shape only. If it were registered as-is against the athamaru's own saves it would be a false positive: the player would see a star on their own Fort/Ref/Will for a bonus they do not get.

name: Ant Kholo
engineNote: Two of the three clauses land cleanly on Deception. The third is an initiative roll: the app has no initiative stat, so a player rolling Deception for initiative gets no prompt at the moment that matters. Folding the clause into the Deception condition text is the best available approximation; a real fix needs an initiative surface (or a rule that skill stars also show on an initiative roll made with that skill).

name: Kanchil
engineNote: Same gap as Ant Kholo: the initiative clause has no target kind because the app has no initiative stat. Folded into the Deception condition text as the best approximation; a proper fix needs an initiative surface or a rule that a skill's stars follow it into an initiative roll. The trained-skill grant is already an effectChoices block.

name: Tsukumogami Poppet
engineNote: Two problems. (1) The target is a Lore the PLAYER picks at character creation ("Cooking Lore for a kitchen knife"), so a static registry cannot name it — the real file's `lore:*` detail form needs a variant that resolves to the character's chosen Lore, or the star has to be attached to whichever Lore this heritage granted. Note the record carries `loreChoices`-style freedom but no effectChoices block naming the Lore, so the chosen value may not even be recorded. (2) The size changes from +2 to +3 if the character has the Helpful Poppet feat, so the printed bonus is conditional on another record being present. The weakness-material choice is already an effectChoices block and is not a bonus.

name: Half Moon Sarangay
engineNote: The two target Lores are player-chosen (the record carries `loreChoices: 2`), so a static registry entry cannot name the skill keys. The engine needs a target that resolves to "the Lore skills granted by this record" — otherwise the star either goes on every Lore (over-reporting) or on none. Everything else on this heritage is flavour.

name: Born of Item
engineNote: Two problems. (1) TARGET RESOLUTION: the skill is the player's own `loreChoices: 1` pick, so a static registry entry cannot name it - the lookup must resolve the heritage's chosen Lore to a concrete `lore:<name>` key at render time. (2) Like Born of Celestial, the only condition is being in Humanoid Form, so if forms are not modelled this is an unconditional +1 that belongs in the maths. The Yaoguai Form clause (success on a mental effect becomes a critical success) is a degree-of-success upgrade, not a bonus - no entry.

name: Born of Vegetation
engineNote: The Yaoguai Form clause grants a +1 circumstance bonus to SOMEONE ELSE'S Medicine check to Treat your Wounds (conditional on light/darkness and your plant or fungus trait). There is no target kind for another creature's check, so it is deliberately omitted rather than mis-filed onto this character's Medicine. The 'add your level to the HP you regain' clause is a healing amount, not a check bonus.

name: Mechanical Symbiosis
engineNote: TARGET UNKNOWN BY DESIGN: the affected skill is 'an additional skill in which the clockwork entity is well-versed, determined by the GM' - the record does not name it and the character sheet does not store it, so `skill` is left unset rather than guessed or widened to 'all' (which would star every skill). The bonus is also opt-in with a real downside, so it must never be folded into any total.

name: Saved by Clockwork
engineNote: NO INITIATIVE TARGET EXISTS. Initiative is usually rolled with Perception, so `perception` is the closest available kind (the existing registry already does this for 'all-this-has-happened-before' and 'ambush-awareness'), but that is wrong whenever the character rolls initiative with Stealth, Deception, etc. It must NOT be added to the Perception total, since it does not apply to Seek, Sense Motive, or passive Perception DC. A real initiative stat would fix this whole family of entries. The daily 10 minutes of maintenance is a flavour/upkeep clause with GM-determined consequences.

name: Close Ties
engineNote: IMPORTANT - do not register this blindly. The Bickering bonus is NOT part of Close Ties: it comes from the 'Family' background adjustment block that the Willowshore player's guide prints once and that this importer has appended verbatim to all four Willowshore backgrounds (close-ties, folklore-enthusiast, northridge-scholar, outskirt-dweller). It is an OPT-IN replacement for the background's skill feat, and it is available to ANY background, not just these four. Registering it on the background id would star Fort/Ref/Will for every character with one of these backgrounds, including those who never took the adjustment. It also triggers on ANOTHER PC's critical failure, which the app cannot detect. The 'Close-Knit' option lowers a DC by 5 rather than granting a bonus, so it has no entry.

name: Folklore Enthusiast
engineNote: Identical situation to Close Ties - the only typed bonus in this record is the duplicated, opt-in Family/Foundling adjustment boilerplate, not anything Folklore Enthusiast itself grants. See the Close Ties note; the same decision covers all four Willowshore backgrounds.

name: Northridge Scholar
engineNote: Identical situation to Close Ties - shared, opt-in adjustment boilerplate, not a Northridge Scholar benefit. See the Close Ties note.

name: Outskirt Dweller
engineNote: Identical situation to Close Ties - shared, opt-in adjustment boilerplate. The granted Terrain Expertise (forest) does carry a +1 circumstance bonus in forest terrain, but that belongs on the terrain-expertise FEAT record, not on this background.

name: Haunted
engineNote: The bonus applies to exactly ONE skill — the second trained skill "determined by the GM" — but the record stores only trainedSkill: 'occultism' and has no field for the entity's skill, so it cannot be targeted precisely. Using skill: 'all' stars every skill; a per-character stored choice (like the existing trainedLoreChoice pattern) would let it target the right one.

engineNote: Two gaps. (1) targetMatches() in situationalBonuses.ts has no 'strikeDamage' case — its only attack case is kind 'attack' -> ref.kind 'strikeAttack', so the damage entry will never match until a damage case is added. (2) The printed text says "attack rolls", which includes spell attacks, but only strikeAttack is representable. The granted Diehard general feat is a feat grant, not a bonus, and is out of scope here.

engineNote: There is no counteract-check stat in the app; 'spell' is the nearest modelled target (spell attack / DC), so the star would land on the spellcasting stat rather than on Cleanse Affliction's counteract roll. The bonus also only exists from 4th level, which the registry shape has no way to express — the level gate has to live in the `when` text.

name: Reborn Soul
engineNote: The two Lore skills are chosen with the GM (record has trainedLoreChoice: true) and the text explicitly also covers "other skill checks that echo your past life", so no fixed skill key exists — skill: 'all' is genuinely correct for the second clause but over-marks for the first. Reading the character's chosen lore ids would let the two Lore skills be starred distinctly.

engineNote: The bonus is on the animal companion's saving throws, not the PC's. The situational lookup runs off characterFeatIds against the PC's own StatRefs, and the companion block has no starred-stat display at all, so there is nowhere for this to render today. Do not key it to the PC's saves — that would be flatly wrong. The success->critical-success upgrade is a degree-of-success change, not a bonus; it is carried in the bonus string only so the player sees it in the same note.

name: Steadfast Strider
engineNote: Two gaps. (1) The target is the animal companion's defences, not the PC's, and the companion block has no starred-stat display — do not key this to the PC's saves.
